boost-focus-with-40hz-binaural-beats.note: The inherited record makes unsourced neuroscience, attention, EEG, reaction-time, comparative-benefit, session-design and safety claims around 40 Hz binaural beats. Because those claims are central to the recommendation rather than incidental wording, the record is withheld from normal discovery and trusted recommendations pending actual source review instead of being converted into unsupported practical guidance.

brag-doc-wins-hub.note: The inherited article contained fabricated pilot and user outcomes, unsupported confidence and motivation effects, arbitrary logging frequencies, pseudo-precise timing and invented retrieval improvements. The effective public record is narrowed to maintaining a compact reusable record of completed work, solved problems, decisions and contributions without claiming psychological or performance effects.

break-familiarity-bias.note: The inherited article contained fabricated prototype results, invented satisfaction changes, unsupported mechanism claims, arbitrary trial counts and universal statements about cues and habit formation. The effective public record is a low-stakes decision check: identify the familiar default, name the criterion that matters, compare one viable alternative and update the default only when the comparison produces a concrete reason.

bullet-point-coach.note: The inherited article contained fabricated clarity, meeting and follow-up outcomes, unsupported working-memory explanations, invented client observations and rigid prescriptions for bullet counts, word counts, rehearsal doses and speaking rhythm. The effective public record is a simple cue-outline protocol for clear spoken updates without claiming measured performance gains.

brag-doc-wins-hub.reason: The effective protocol creates a compact work record designed for later retrieval and reuse, then folds that record into recurring review and planning. Information Management is primary; Work Systems covers the repeated capture-and-review workflow.

break-familiarity-bias.reason: The effective protocol examines whether a familiar default is being accepted without comparison and uses an explicit criterion to compare a viable alternative. Cognitive Biases captures the default-check lens; Decision Making captures the choice procedure.
